description: Ego-policy swap experiment over scenarios/benchmark -- four junction scenarios on Town10HD_Opt and three highway scenarios on Town04. Each scenario is run twice: once as compiled (the ego driven by its behaviour-tree timeline) and once with the ego's actuation handed to the IDM policy through the --ego-policy entry point. Everything else about the scenario -- NPC timelines, events, monitors, spawn geometry -- is identical between the two arms.

idm_parameters.note: Library defaults, identical across all seven scenarios, so the arm differs only in the controller and not in per-scenario tuning.

scenarios.name: red_light
scenarios.intent: A vehicle running the crossing red T-bones the ego inside the junction.

scenarios.name: right_turn
scenarios.intent: A vehicle already on the lane the ego turns onto rear-ends it.

scenarios.name: left_turn
scenarios.intent: An oncoming vehicle strikes the ego mid unprotected-left-turn.

scenarios.name: stop_sign
scenarios.intent: The ego negotiates an unsignalised crossing by precedence and nothing is hit.

scenarios.name: lane_change
scenarios.intent: The ego changes into the one neighbouring lane that is occupied, after the vehicle ahead brakes hard.

scenarios.name: cut_in
scenarios.intent: A faster vehicle passes the ego, cuts in ~7 m ahead of it and slows; the ego runs into the back of it.

scenarios.name: overtake
scenarios.intent: The ego pulls out past a slow lorry into the oncoming lane and meets an oncoming car head-on.
